sql_template: SELECT SUM(charged_amount) FROM zs_observe.amazon_oms WHERE is_active = true AND transaction_type = 'forward';
SELECT SUM(charged_amount) FROM zs_observe.amazon_oms WHERE is_active = true AND transaction_type IN ('forward', 'reverse');

SELECT sku_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type='forward' THEN order_id END) AS forward_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type='reverse' THEN order_id END) AS returns FROM zs_observe.amazon_oms WHERE is_active = true GROUP BY sku_id;

SELECT CASE WHEN tax_igst_rate > 0 THEN 'Inter-State (IGST)' WHEN tax_cgst_rate > 0 THEN 'Intra-State (CGST+SGST)' WHEN tax_ugst_rate > 0 THEN 'Union Territory' ELSE 'No Tax / Other' END AS gst_type, SUM(total_tax), SUM(charged_amount_excluding_tax) FROM zs_observe.amazon_oms WHERE is_active = true AND transaction_type = 'forward' GROUP BY 1;

SELECT settlement_id, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Order' THEN product_sales ELSE 0 END) AS gross_sales, SUM(total) AS net_settled, SUM(total) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Order' THEN product_sales ELSE 0 END), 0) AS realization_rate FROM zs_observe.amazon_settlement WHERE is_active = true GROUP BY settlement_id;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_date) AS month, SUM(total) AS advertising_spend FROM zs_observe.amazon_settlement WHERE is_active = true AND type = 'Service Fee' AND description LIKE '%Advertising%' GROUP BY 1;
SELECT settlement_id, SUM(total) AS net_cash_position FROM zs_observe.amazon_settlement WHERE is_active = true GROUP BY settlement_id;
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_date) AS month, SUM(tds) AS tds_total, SUM(tcs_igst + tcs_cgst + tcs_sgst) AS tcs_total FROM zs_observe.amazon_settlement WHERE is_active = true GROUP BY 1;
SELECT charged_amount_type, SUM(charged_amount) AS amount FROM zs_observe.amazon_disbursment WHERE is_active = true AND mp_fee_type = 'ItemFees' GROUP BY charged_amount_type;

SELECT sku_id, ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN mp_fee_type='ItemFees' AND charged_amount_type='commission' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN mp_fee_type='ItemPrice' AND charged_amount_type='principal' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS effective_commission_rate FROM zs_observe.amazon_disbursment WHERE is_active = true GROUP BY sku_id;

WITH actual_fees AS (SELECT sku_id, SUM(CASE WHEN mp_fee_type='ItemFees' AND transaction_type='Order' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END) AS actual_fee FROM zs_observe.amazon_disbursment WHERE is_active = true GROUP BY sku_id) SELECT fp.sku, fp.gross_commission AS expected_fee, a.actual_fee, fp.gross_commission + a.actual_fee AS variance FROM zs_observe.amazon_fee_preview fp JOIN actual_fees a ON fp.sku = a.sku_id WHERE fp.is_active = true AND fp.zen_status = true AND fp.is_duplicated = false;

SELECT sku, gross_weight, volumetric_weight, final_weight FROM zs_observe.amazon_fee_preview WHERE is_active = true AND zen_status = true AND is_duplicated = false AND volumetric_weight > gross_weight * 1.5;
SELECT return_reason, COUNT(*) AS return_count, SUM(charged_amount) AS total_refund FROM zs_observe.amazon_returns WHERE is_active = true GROUP BY return_reason ORDER BY return_count DESC;
SELECT SUM(charged_amount_excluding_tax) AS taxable_revenue FROM zs_observe.amazon_oms WHERE is_active = true AND transaction_type = 'forward';
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN mp_fee_type = 'ItemPrice' AND charged_amount_type = 'principal' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END) AS principal_revenue FROM zs_observe.amazon_disbursment WHERE is_active = true;
SELECT SUM(charged_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 0) AS average_order_value FROM zs_observe.amazon_oms WHERE is_active = true AND transaction_type = 'forward';

SELECT sku_id, ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN mp_fee_type = 'ItemFees' AND charged_amount_type IN ('shipping fee','shipping chargeback') THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN mp_fee_type = 'ItemPrice' AND charged_amount_type = 'principal' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS shipping_cost_rate FROM zs_observe.amazon_disbursment WHERE is_active = true AND transaction_type = 'Order' GROUP BY sku_id;
SELECT sku, gross_commission / NULLIF(charged_amount, 0) AS fee_burden FROM zs_observe.amazon_fee_preview WHERE is_active = true AND zen_status = true AND is_duplicated = false;

SELECT sku_id, ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN mp_fee_type = 'ItemFees' AND charged_amount_type = 'commission' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END)) AS forward_fee FROM zs_observe.amazon_disbursment WHERE is_active = true AND transaction_type = 'Order' GROUP BY sku_id;
SELECT settlement_id, SUM(settled_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 0) AS net_settlement_per_order FROM zs_observe.amazon_settlement WHERE is_active = true GROUP BY settlement_id;

SELECT charged_amount_type, (SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Refund' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Fulfillment Fee Refund' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Order' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END)), 0) AS recovery_rate FROM zs_observe.amazon_disbursment WHERE is_active = true AND mp_fee_type IN ('ItemFees','Item Fee Adjustment','ItemTCS','ItemTDS') GROUP BY charged_amount_type;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'cancel' THEN order_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type IN ('forward','cancel') THEN order_id END), 0) AS cancellation_rate FROM zs_observe.amazon_oms WHERE is_active = true;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type IN ('forward','reverse') THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'forward' THEN order_id END), 0) AS net_revenue_per_forward_order FROM zs_observe.amazon_oms WHERE is_active = true;

SELECT AVG(ABS(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'reverse' THEN charged_amount END)) / NULLIF(AVG(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'forward' THEN charged_amount END), 0) AS return_value_rate FROM zs_observe.amazon_oms WHERE is_active = true;

SELECT sku_id, SUM(item_promo_discount) / NULLIF(SUM(item_amount_excluding_tax), 0) AS discount_depth FROM zs_observe.amazon_oms WHERE is_active = true AND transaction_type = 'forward' GROUP BY sku_id;

description: SAFE-T recovery rate proxy by settlement period
sql_template: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', s.settlement_date) AS settlement_period, SUM(CASE WHEN s.type = 'SAFE-T Reimbursement' THEN s.total ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_reason IN ('DAMAGED_BY_FC','DAMAGED_BY_CARRIER','SWITCHEROO','UNAUTHORIZED_PURCHASE','NOT_AS_DESCRIBED') THEN ABS(r.charged_amount) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS safe_t_recovery_rate FROM zs_observe.amazon_settlement s JOIN zs_observe.amazon_returns r ON s.order_id = r.order_id WHERE s.is_active = true AND r.is_active = true GROUP BY 1;

SELECT order_id, ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Refund' AND mp_fee_type = 'ItemPrice' AND charged_amount_type = 'principal' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END)) + GREATEST(0, ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Order' AND charged_amount_type = 'shipping fee' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END)) - SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Fulfillment Fee Refund' AND charged_amount_type = 'shipping fee' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END)) + GREATEST(0, ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Order' AND charged_amount_type = 'tech fee' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END)) - SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Fulfillment Fee Refund' AND charged_amount_type = 'tech fee' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END)) + ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Order' AND charged_amount_type = 'pickup fee' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END)) + GREATEST(0, ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Order' AND charged_amount_type = 'commission' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END)) - SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Refund' AND charged_amount_type = 'refund commission' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END)) + GREATEST(0, ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Order' AND charged_amount_type = 'closing fee' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END)) - SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Refund' AND charged_amount_type = 'closing fee' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END)) + 0.60 * ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Order' AND charged_amount_type = 'tcs gst' THEN charged_amount ELSE 0 END)) AS return_loss FROM zs_observe.amazon_disbursment WHERE is_active = true AND transaction_type IN ('Order','Refund','Fulfillment Fee Refund') GROUP BY order_id;

SELECT destination_state, SUM(charged_amount) AS gross_revenue FROM zs_observe.amazon_oms WHERE is_active = true AND transaction_type = 'forward' GROUP BY destination_state ORDER BY gross_revenue DESC;

SELECT order_id, sku_id, SUM(charged_amount) AS chargeback_amount FROM zs_observe.amazon_disbursment WHERE is_active = true AND charged_amount_type = 'shipping chargeback' GROUP BY order_id, sku_id ORDER BY ABS(SUM(charged_amount)) DESC;

SELECT CASE WHEN metadata IS NULL THEN 'International' ELSE metadata END AS segment, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders, SUM(charged_amount) AS gross_revenue FROM zs_observe.amazon_oms WHERE is_active = true AND transaction_type = 'forward' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY gross_revenue DESC;
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_active = true) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS active_rate FROM zs_observe.amazon_oms;

SELECT MIN(created_date) AS earliest, MAX(created_date) AS latest, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_date)) AS month_count FROM zs_observe.amazon_oms WHERE is_active = true AND transaction_type = 'forward';

SELECT 'OMS' AS source, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count, SUM(charged_amount) AS revenue FROM zs_observe.amazon_oms WHERE is_active = true AND transaction_type = 'forward' UNION ALL SELECT 'Settlement' AS source, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), SUM(product_sales) FROM zs_observe.amazon_settlement WHERE is_active = true AND type = 'Order';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.sku_id) AS oms_skus, COUNT(DISTINCT fp.sku) AS preview_skus, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fp.sku IS NOT NULL THEN o.sku_id END) AS matched_skus FROM zs_observe.amazon_oms o LEFT JOIN zs_observe.amazon_fee_preview fp ON o.sku_id = fp.sku AND fp.is_active = true AND fp.zen_status = true AND fp.is_duplicated = false WHERE o.is_active = true AND o.transaction_type = 'forward';
SELECT SUM(total_tax) / NULLIF(SUM(charged_amount_excluding_tax), 0) AS effective_tax_rate FROM zs_observe.amazon_oms WHERE is_active = true AND transaction_type = 'forward';

SELECT settlement_id, SUM(total) AS recorded_total, SUM(product_sales + selling_fees + fba_fees + shipping_credits + promotional_rebates + gift_wrap_credits + other_transaction_fees + other - tcs_igst - tcs_cgst - tcs_sgst - tds) AS formula_total FROM zs_observe.amazon_settlement WHERE is_active = true GROUP BY settlement_id;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_return_rows FROM zs_observe.amazon_returns WHERE is_active = true;
